title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Peer STOP_SENDING Work Item
summary: Add focused DoQ proof for peer STOP_SENDING fatal handling.
planned_changes:
- Add a raw loopback test that aborts the server-side read path on an inbound DoQ query stream and asserts the client turns the peer STOP_SENDING into a fatal protocol error.
- Link the requirement-home, architecture, and verification trace artifacts for REQ-QUIC-RFC9250-0057.
verification_plan: Run the DoQ fatal protocol-error tests, the RFC 9250 requirement-home tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: Missing expected STREAM FIN timeout policy.
Server-initiated bidirectional stream handling, padding, AXFR/IXFR, 0-RTT, Retry/address validation, gateway rewriting, and external DoQ interop proof.
completion_notes: The DoQ client now has a focused proof that a peer STOP_SENDING on the outstanding query stream is treated as a fatal protocol error and closes the connection.
